question: Using Figure 6B-1 and Section 6B.06, list the main TTC-zone areas in travel order and identify the three components of the activity area.
model_answer: Direct Answer: In the direction of travel, a TTC zone is typically divided into four areas: the advance warning area (tells traffic what to expect ahead), the transition area (moves traffic out of its normal path), the activity area (where work takes place), and the termination area (lets traffic resume normal operations). The activity area itself is comprised of three components: the work space, the traffic space, and the buffer space. All of this material is explanatory (Support); no Standard, Guidance, or Option provisions were provided. Visual evidence: [Image 1] Figure 6B-1 shows the four areas in travel order—Advance Warning Area, Transition Area (with shoulder taper), Activity Area (containing the work space, traffic space, and lateral/longitudinal buffer spaces), and Termination Area (with downstream taper). [Image 2] Page 814 contains Section 6B.06, which explains that the activity area is comprised of the work space, traffic space, and buffer space, and describes each. [Image 3] Page 812 contains Section 6B.03, which lists the four component areas of a TTC zone and references Figure 6B-1, plus the descriptions of the advance warning and transition areas. [Image 4] Page 817 describes tapers (shoulder and downstream tapers) that appear in the transition and termination areas of the figure. [Image 5] Page 822 discusses worker safety within the activity area and work space but does not add to the component listing. Support (informational): - "A TTC zone is often divided into four areas as needed, based on engineering judgment: the advance warning area, the transition area, the activity area, and the termination area. Figure 6B-1 illustrates the four areas typically included in a TTC zone." - "The activity area is the section of the highway where the work activity takes place. It is comprised of the work space, the traffic space, and the buffer space." - "The traffic space is the portion of the highway in which road users are routed through the activity area." - The safety of workers performing tasks within the work space is of equal importance to that of the public traveling through the TTC zone, since TTC zones present constantly changing conditions unexpected by road users. Citations: - Section 6B.03 Support §1 (p.771) - Section 6B.06 Support §1 (p.773) - Section 6B.06 Support §5 (p.773) - Section 6A.01 Support §5 (p.765) - Figure 6B-1 (p.772) - Page 814 - Page 812
gold_answer: Advance warning, transition, activity, and termination. The activity area consists of the work space, traffic space, and buffer space.
